Protesters allege Pakistan forces killed 30 in Kashmir firing

Protesters in Pakistan-administered Kashmir allege that Pakistan forces fatally shot at least 30 unarmed demonstrators during a march in Rawalakot. A local civil rights group claims authorities removed evidence of killings amid a communications blackout. The protests reportedly began over inflation and electricity prices. The Guardian reported that at least 30 people are alleged to have been killed in the past two days as part of a state crackdown.
